greeting.text: Hi! Interested in a yoga trial? The first class is free!

lines.text: Your shoulders look a bit stiff. Desk job, right?
Just changing how you breathe changes your day. Really.
We have one-on-one classes too. Even just a consultation is fine.
It's a quiet class. No talking required!

flushRemark.text: Oh, you're tense. Take a deep breath~

closers.endured: I kept you too long. Breathe~
